solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Boycott obligation for formal dress

parts.note: to black something is to boycott it, as a union blacks goods
a tie is a binding commitment or obligation

explanation.surface: A cricket-loving reader might wonder whether Geoffrey Boycott must wear a dinner jacket.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boycott' looks like the Yorkshire cricketer's name but is the verb 'black'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names the dress code requiring a dinner jacket and bow tie, the standard formal evening wear.

clue.text: Part of fridge that is keeping cold in case?

indicators.note: one piece holding another inside it, as a container keeps its contents

parts.note: i.e. (id est) means that is
C is the standard abbreviation for cold on taps
a box is a case or container

explanation.surface: A question about which compartment of a refrigerator keeps things chilled in a container.
explanation.definitionFit: Older refrigerators had a small freezing compartment inside them, known by this name in Britain.

clue.text: Broken — though broken by son

indicators.note: the conjunction is split open by the abbreviation inserted into it

parts.note: but can mean though, as in 'small but strong'
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Something wrecked, yet apparently wrecked by a boy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broken' appears twice: first as the definition, then as the insertion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bust has stopped working, an informal synonym for being out of order.

clue.text: Travelling salesman encountered getting up in a bad mood

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters are read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative who travels to customers
met means encountered

explanation.surface: A grumpy salesman met someone while getting out of bed in a foul mood.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in a temper is to be angry, so the word names an irritable state of mind.

clue.text: Rotary-winged plane gets your goat unfortunately

indicators.note: an unlucky arrangement implies the letters have come out wrongly ordered

explanation.surface: A helicopter-like aircraft irritates you, unhappily.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets your goat' is an idiom for annoys, but only 'your goat' is fodder; 'gets' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an early aircraft lifted by an unpowered rotor, with a separate propeller for thrust.

clue.text: End of a northern race is reported

indicators.note: something reported is spoken, so the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: the Finns are a northern European people; their adjective has a double N

explanation.surface: The close of a race held in the north is announced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'race' suggests a running finish but means a people: the Finns.
explanation.definitionFit: The finishing point of something is its conclusion or end.

clue.text: Ditch colouring material containing potassium

indicators.note: the outer word holds the chemical symbol inside it

parts.note: dye is a substance used to colour fabric
K is the chemical symbol for potassium

explanation.surface: A trench filled with dye and potassium, like a polluted drain.
explanation.definitionFit: In parts of England a dyke is a drainage ditch as well as an embankment.

clue.text: Arranged truce after the French talk

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come after the French article

parts.note: le is French for the

indicators.note: letters arranged anew are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: After a ceasefire was agreed, the French gave a talk.
explanation.definitionFit: A lecture is a formal talk given to an audience.

clue.text: Join university — first year initially

parts.note: uni is the informal short form of university

indicators.note: initially means the opening letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: An instruction to enrol at university in your first year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' is fodder, not an instruction: its own initial is used.
explanation.definitionFit: To unify things is to combine or bring them together into one.

clue.text: Hire vehicle needs old time navigator

parts.note: a cab is a taxi, a vehicle for hire
T is the physics symbol for time

explanation.surface: A hired car is needed by an old-fashioned sailor guiding the way.
explanation.walkthrough: John Cabot was the Venetian explorer who sailed to North America for England in 1497.
explanation.definitionFit: Cabot is a famous example of a navigator, a seafaring explorer charting new coasts.

clue.text: Supply identification when entering show

indicators.note: the short piece goes inside the longer one

parts.note: to prove something is to show or demonstrate it

explanation.surface: An official asks for papers to be shown when entering a building.
explanation.definitionFit: To provide something is to furnish or supply it.

clue.text: Eat dry mix prepared for stuffing

indicators.note: food prepared is made up afresh, signalling the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A recipe instruction: a dry mix to eat, made ready for the stuffing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stuffing' looks culinary but means preserving animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Taxidermy is the craft of stuffing and mounting dead animals for display.

clue.text: Brings out diamonds the day before and takes off

parts.note: D is the card abbreviation for diamonds
eve is the day before an event, as in Christmas Eve
to lop is to cut off

explanation.surface: Someone produces jewels the day before and then leaves.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographer develops film to bring out its image, and a person develops an idea by bringing it out.

clue.text: Cool joint

definitions.meaning: the ball-and-socket joint at the top of the leg

explanation.surface: A trendy cannabis cigarette.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both slang for trendy and the name of the leg joint at the pelvis.

clue.text: See me in repeat broadcast that's diffuse

indicators.note: the pronoun is placed inside the scrambled letters
broadcast seeds are scattered, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: Watch me in a rerun on television that seems rambling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diffuse' reads as an adjective (wordy) but is the verb, spread through.
explanation.definitionFit: To permeate is to spread throughout something, the verb sense of diffuse.

clue.text: Period of history covered by several

indicators.note: the letters sit concealed within the word that follows

explanation.surface: A historical age that many textbooks deal with.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a distinct age or epoch in history.

clue.text: A male in speech is unconcerned with right or wrong

parts.note: oral means spoken, in speech

explanation.surface: A man who, by what he says, shows no conscience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in speech' looks like a sound-alike signal, but it simply means spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: An amoral person lacks any moral sense, neither caring about nor recognising ethics.

clue.text: Vehicle insurance needed around centre of rough Canadian port

parts.note: a van is a goods vehicle

indicators.note: the insurance word wraps around the single letter

parts.note: cover is insurance protection

indicators.note: centre means the middle letter of the word

explanation.surface: A van needs insurance to drive around a rough part of a Canadian port.
explanation.definitionFit: Vancouver is the major Pacific seaport of British Columbia in Canada.

clue.text: Still receiving deliveries with no attempt to sell

parts.note: to tout is to try to sell, as a ticket tout does

explanation.surface: A householder still getting parcels with no salesman pestering.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a batsman not out is still batting, so still facing the bowler's balls, called deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: A cricket batsman described this way remains in and keeps facing balls bowled.

clue.text: Some are gay overtly, rising to go cruising

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the letters read upwards, backwards
only part of the following words is used, a stretch concealed in them

explanation.surface: Some people are openly gay, getting up to go cruising.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cruising' suggests the gay scene but means sailing.
explanation.definitionFit: To voyage is to travel by sea, as a cruise ship's passengers do.

clue.text: Let fall and let tear

parts.note: to drop is to let fall
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to drop something and allow a rip to happen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tear' reads as a rip (rhymes with bear) but is the drop from an eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A tear from the eye is a tiny drop of liquid, a small bead of water.

clue.text: Had a meal after daughter's engagement

indicators.note: the meal word comes after the abbreviation

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter; the 's is 'has', a link
ate means had a meal

explanation.surface: A family ate together after their daughter announced she was getting married.
explanation.definitionFit: A date is a social engagement or appointment.

clue.text: Flower of Scotland — that runs close to Glasgow's heart

definitions.meaning: a flower is a thing that flows, a river, in Scotland

definitions.text: that runs close to Glasgow's heart
definitions.meaning: the river running through central Glasgow

explanation.surface: The Scottish anthem, beloved of every Glaswegian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower of Scotland' is the unofficial Scottish anthem; here a flower is something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: The Clyde is the great Scottish river flowing through the middle of Glasgow.

clue.text: Joker perhaps was concerned with English being banned

indicators.note: the abbreviation is barred, so removed from the word

parts.note: cared means was concerned

explanation.surface: The puzzle's setter, Joker, minded about English being outlawed.
explanation.walkthrough: Joker is this puzzle's setter, a nice self-reference.
explanation.definitionFit: A joker is a playing card, and also a card in the sense of a wag.

clue.text: Vagrant putting pressure on public transport

indicators.note: in an across clue, the letter is placed after, on the end of, the vehicle

parts.note: a tram is a public transport vehicle on rails
P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: A homeless person pressing to get aboard a bus or tram.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp is a homeless wanderer, a vagrant.

clue.text: Just piano, honest

explanation.surface: Simply a piano, to be truthful.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means righteous and honourable, and also names a vertical piano.
